2169-4694-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-7306-8227.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-3835-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

549-856-4247-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

206-222-527-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-4247.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

628-4247-7200.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-7286.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

654-3129-4365-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4659-5086-5183-7743-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-7743-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

997-1580-4871-6112.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-1409-4289-5223.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3755-7686-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-7686-7730.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-7686-7730.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7724.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2350-3532-5078-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1368-4068-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one Mountain.
1368-4068-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

262-1242-2433.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating at least one creature token.
When the token enters, Rosie triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cinderhaze Wretch.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
262-1242-2433.notes: If Cinderhaze Wretch starts with power 2 or greater, you'll make more tokens each loop and can place +1/+1 counters on other creatures after placing the first.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3334-4762-4772.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Lae'zel.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1558-2638-3147-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3147-4231-4321.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

280-423-1437-5478.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
280-423-1437-5478.description:
Cast Spelunking by paying {2}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Spelunking spell three times.
Resolve the first Spelunking copy.
The Spelunking token enters the battlefield, drawing a card then putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped.
Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
In response, activate the land by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
280-423-1437-5478.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Spelunking. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

4659-4772-5346-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4742-4846-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4742-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

338-4050-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4050-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 2.

475-5078-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
475-5078-6900.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

628-3108-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability
Repeat.
628-3108-4779.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

2438-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

527-725-2034-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 2 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
527-725-2034-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{U} plus an additional {X} equal to Sin's power minus 3.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Selvala.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Selvala.
Repeat.

60-518-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
60-518-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

1305-3232-6575.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
As Esper Terra enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with four lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it and Obsidan Battle-Axe trigger.
Resolve the Terra trigger, causing you to mill five cards and put up to one enchantment card milled this way into your hand.
Resolve the Obsidian Battle-Axe trigger, attaching it to Terra.
Repeat.

2781-3504.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mercurial Pretender.
2781-3504.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Mercurial Pretender enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Mercurial Pretender. Choose to have Mercurial Pretender enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2482-2653-5624.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Nervous Gardener enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

1339-4279-5070.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4279-5070.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4720-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1550-4367.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to another creature without summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
1550-4367.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Akki Battle Squad, then searching your library for a basic land card and exiling it, then putting the land and Akki Battle Squad onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1368-1878-2706.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least six additional cards in your graveyard, plus an additional six cards between your hand and/or graveyard.
An opponent has at least six cards in hand.
1368-1878-2706.description:
Cast Jeska's Will from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, adding at least six {R}.
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Repeat.

1902-1909-4499-4852.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
1902-1909-4499-4852.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Elvish Mystic from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Wirewood Symbiote.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Repeat.

3272-3525-4289-4832.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
3272-3525-4289-4832.description:
Cast Ensoul Artifact enchanting Immovable Rod.
Cast Pemmin's Aura enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

518-3640-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering itself, targeting any creature.
In response, cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the same creature and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Resolve Volcano Hellion's trigger, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to you, reducing your life total to 1 due to Fortune Thief.
Arcbond's delayed triggered ability triggers, dealing an equal amount of damage to all other creatures and all players, which again does not reduce your life total below 1.
